test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The news of the robbery spread faster than ________.
solution:
The correct answer is 'fire'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate answer is 'fire'.
 
• The actual idiom is 'spread like wildfire' which means 'to become known very quickly'.
 
• A variation of the same idiom is given in the sentence.
 
• Hence, the appropriate answer is 'fire'.
